arguments.sql: SELECT o.order_date, o.status, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Herramientas Lozano S.L.') AND o.id = 100 GROUP BY o.id

arguments.subject: Pedido n.º 100
arguments.body: Queremos informarle que recibimos su pedido n.º 100 el 20-01-2025. El importe total es 3004 EUR.
